claim: In the STS comparison table, AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity can be called by any user who passes an OIDC compliant JWT token from a known identity provider; it has no MFA support but supports session policies, and lasts from 15 m up to the maximum session duration setting with a default of 1 hr.
question: Who can call AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity and does it support MFA?

values.display: any user who passes an OIDC compliant JWT token from a known identity provider
no MFA support but supports session policies
